teacher_basis.training_conditions: Teacher seventh email:four DINO augmentation conditions x3 training seeds, CLIP combined x1

primary_suite_basis: Pinned official lifelong/evaluate.py accepts exactly spatial/object/goal/10
libero90_role: Not part of the proposed primary40; no claim of evaluating all130 tasks. Existing single engineering task stays excluded.

bounded_per_suite100.scope: Bounded evaluation only, not automatically the final thesis requirement

initial_state_rule.source: Pinned official .pruned_init assets; no demonstrations or synthesized states
initial_state_rule.duplicates: Repeat counts/unique initial-state indices must be reported;100 trials need not mean100 distinct physical states
initial_state_rule.seeds: SHA256([20261026,task_key,episode_slot,channel]), first64 bits mod2^31-1 for environment or2^63-1 for sampler
initial_state_rule.paired_across: Same task/slot/seeds for all model conditions and training seeds; seeds exclude condition, training seed and phrasing
initial_state_rule.reset_policy_per_episode: Reset callback call counter and use fixed per-episode sampler seed; never reload/train the model between trials

language.primary: Official benchmark task.language from grab_language_from_filename; never substitute BDDL wording silently
language.evaluation_paraphrases: Five semantically reviewed phrasings, retained outside training; freeze text before scoring those variants
language.training_languages: No LIBERO task language/demo/init is added to OXE training or augmentation banks

execution.settle_gripper_history: Zero native gripper is neutral; keep command history unknown, not falsely known open/closed
execution.checkpoint: Immutable final65536 endpoint; no intermediate/best/target-outcome checkpoint selection
execution.frozen_state: Exact training digest; use explicit verified original coefficient profile on a different runtime

control.timing_evidence: User-selected published nominal Bridge/LT5Hz, BC-Z10Hz, Fractal3Hz resampled to5Hz; no measured export timestamps. Actual native20Hz checked at execution.
control.tcp_mapping_evidence: Engineering transfer convention: interpret model source-Cartesian deltas at measured LIBERO EEF world pose; source-specific units/base/TCP alignment is not calibrated or proven by this file.

execution.transfer_assumption: Evaluate the already-declared uncalibrated shared-Cartesian convention as an explicit experimental setting, not as proven calibration

policy_inputs.rgb: Only upright agentview RGB through the training prepare_image path
policy_inputs.language: Frozen CLIP text encoding of official benchmark language
policy_inputs.proprioception: Last explicit gripper command plus availability; no joint/EEF/object coordinates passed to the learned network
policy_inputs.eef_reference: Measured EEF pose is used only by the fixed native OSC conversion, not as an added learned feature

success.predicate: Official native BDDL goal predicate as returned by LIBERO step done, with goal status recorded
success.decision: At least one success during at most600 actual policy control ticks; stop at first success
success.no_surrogates: Position loss, reward proxies, arm motion and8-decision engineering connection do not count as task success

baseline.reuse: One fixed baseline result per task/slot; reuse across model/training seeds and language variants rather than rerun identical trials

statistics.per_task: Success count/planned completed trials; never silently omit technical errors
statistics.per_suite: Equal-weight mean over10 task success rates
statistics.overall: Equal-weight mean over4 suite means; also publish each suite separately
statistics.training_seeds: Report mean and sample SD(ddof1) over42/43/44 when all three available; single-seed results have no invented training-seed SD
statistics.paired_comparisons: Match task/slot and training seed; scene resampling clusters by official initial-state index
statistics.clip_ablation: Single training seed; do not treat episode bootstrap as three-seed evidence

errors_and_resume.technical_errors: Report evaluation incomplete; retry the identical task/slot/seeds only, no resampled easier episodes
errors_and_resume.native_horizon_failure: A valid rollout with no goal by600 ticks is a task failure
errors_and_resume.resume: Completed episode identities are immutable, skipped only after checkpoint/protocol/asset hashes match
errors_and_resume.selection: No algorithm/control/data/budget/checkpoint changes based on final scores; a changed method gets a new exploratory protocol

storage.episode_reports: Compact per-episode results and trace digests, not per-episode full simulator dumps
storage.videos: If enabled, choose task/episode identifiers before outcomes, never select successes only

remaining_before_scoring: Bind actual evaluator code and per-run checkpoint/profile identities
